import json,sys,datetime,collections
POS={"good","great","happy","win","shipped","calm"};NEG={"bad","tired","stress","sad","angry","stuck"}

def summarize(name,notes):

# Conscious
AI journaling/reflection platform prototype: logs entries, scores mood, surfaces weekly insights.
Run: python app.py

## Usage
`python app.py "felt great, shipped a feature"` adds an entry; `python app.py` prints daily mood averages.
## Roadmap
- LLM-based reflection prompts
- weekly trend summary
- web UI

## Parent summary (for tutors)
`python summary.py "Name" "got fractions" "needs practice on decimals"` prints a parent-ready session update.
## Privacy
Notes processed in memory; only the approved summary is saved; deletion confirmed in writing within 7 days.

## Demo
`python summary.py "Aarav" "got fractions" "needs practice on decimals"`
Output: wins and next-practice list, ready to paste to parents.
import sys
def summarize(name,notes):
    pos=[n for n in notes if any(k in n.lower() for k in("good","great","improved","got it"))]

# Conscious
AI journaling/reflection platform prototype: logs entries, scores mood, surfaces weekly insights.
Run: python app.py

## Usage
`python app.py "felt great, shipped a feature"` adds an entry; `python app.py` prints daily mood averages.
## Roadmap
- LLM-based reflection prompts
- weekly trend summary
- web UI

## Parent summary (for tutors)
`python summary.py "Name" "got fractions" "needs practice on decimals"` prints a parent-ready session update.
## Privacy
Notes processed in memory; only the approved summary is saved; deletion confirmed in writing within 7 days.

## Demo
`python summary.py "Aarav" "got fractions" "needs practice on decimals"`
Output: wins and next-practice list, ready to paste to parents.
